name: Esko
tagline: Esko builds the structural design and prepress tools much of the packaging industry runs on, including ArtiosCAD for dielines and ArtPro+ for prepress. Its AI-assisted automation checks artwork against brand and print specs and flags structural or color errors before a design goes to press, catching mistakes that would otherwise show up on a production run.
